QuestInfo.name: Investigate the Brawl 'n' Bash Club 2
QuestInfo.0: Something is off about this place where Mr. Hazard's underlings have gathered. You should talk to them and learn what you can.
QuestInfo.1: As you try to investigate, you are attacked by Mr. Hazard's goons. Looks like you'll have to fight.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated all of Mr. Hazard's lackeys who attacked you.

1.0: Those meathead guards are all gone.\r\n
1.1: We need to find the info and get out of here before they come back with reinforcements...\r\n

yes.0: They're probably extra-alert now, after all that commotion. We need a plan.\r\n
